utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool’s still on for tomorrow, but one of the parents might be running a few minutes late. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still on for tomorrow, right? Just let me know if the time shifts at all.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, still on for tomorrow. I’ll tell you right away if the time shifts at all.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll mention the carpool plan to the others and make sure everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I probably would’ve missed that otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll bring it up with everyone and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’d say be ready by 8:15 — I’ll swing by right after I grab my coffee.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll be ready by 8:15.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — could you do 8:15? That would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 8:15 works for me. I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I can coordinate the carpool around the school schedule. What days and times are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — weekdays after school would be best, especially around 3:30. I can help fill in the rest of the seats if that works.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — I can handle weekdays around 3:30 after school. Send me the days you need, and we’ll fill the remaining seats.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: who’s driving, and what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — I can drive. Be ready at 8:15, and I’ll swing by.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, 8:15 works for me. I’ll be ready when you pull up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, if you’re still up for the carpool, I can put you down and share the pickup time with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please put me down — just send me the pickup time and any changes as soon as you know them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you down, and I’ll send the pickup time and any updates to everyone as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I just heard there might be a change with the carpool—what did you find out?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m checking on it now and I’ll let you know as soon as I have the details. If there’s a change, I’ll make sure everyone on the route hears about it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa—just let me know when you know. I’ll pass it along if I hear anything too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the pickup time and who’s in the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I don’t have the pickup time or roster in front of me right now—send me the details and I’ll help keep track.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No problem—I'll send the pickup time and roster once I have them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I can do the carpool this week. Just let me know the times and I’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — I’ll send the times over and keep it easy.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I appreciate it — just send them when you can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — I can lend a hand if you need anything for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Can you pick up the kids on Tuesday and Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I can do Tuesday and Thursday for the kids.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of who’s where for the carpool—just tell me the pickup spots and times.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — I’ll send you the pickup spots and times in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — I’ll watch for them and keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—what do you need for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I just wanted to check if there’s room for one more rider tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got room for one more tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d feel better if we confirm the pickup times and who’s driving each day so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, let’s confirm it before we assume anything. Who’s driving each day?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can take Monday and Wednesday if that helps, and we should fill in the rest from there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I can help coordinate the carpool and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — that really helps. I’ll send you the riders’ names and pickup times this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — send them over when you have a chance, and I’ll put everything together. Happy to help keep it smooth.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the carpool supplies and make sure we’ve got everything ready. What time are we leaving?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’m probably going to join a bit late, but I can still help load up if you need me. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That works — I was thinking around 8:00, so even if you’re a little late, you can still catch us before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool time might be shifting a bit this week — I’m checking on it now.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate you checking. Just let me know what time it ends up being so I can plan the school run.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I will — I’m waiting on the final time and I’ll pass it along as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just send me the pickup time and address, and I’ll do my best to be there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll text you the pickup time and address shortly. Thanks, Bo!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks Rosa — I’ll look for your text and be ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Leo — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What days and times are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam. I’m thinking weekdays around 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m.; does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, that works for me on weekdays. I can do both the morning and evening rides.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m happy to help organize the carpool—want me to text everyone and see who’s in?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That would be amazing, thanks — I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so a quick text would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send a quick group text right now and get a headcount. I’ll let you know who’s in as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the pickup spot and time—just tell me where you want me to note it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s note the front curb at 8:15 sharp. That way we keep it simple and on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — front curb at 8:15 sharp. I’ll note it exactly like that.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the carpool tomorrow? If so, what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we’re still on—could you be ready by 7:30? I’ll confirm if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yep, 7:30 works for me. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the carpool might need one more driver this week. If you want, I can ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be really kind of you, Ira. I think we might still need one more driver, so please ask around if you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and let you know what I find.
